name: Cobos de Cerrato (Spain)
description: Divided by a curving line from the lower hoist to the upper fly, yellow at the upper hoist with three black arched openings and green at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Cobos de Cerrato; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: three arched openings (dovecote holes) at the upper hoist
